# Documentation Changes

Read [ADR-0022](../../docs/internal/architecture/adr/0022-adopt-audience-local-diataxis-documentation.md)
before changing repository documentation. Keep content in its audience-owned
area: public usage in `docs/developer`, implementation and maintainer guidance
in `docs/internal`, product intent in `docs/product`, and presentation material
in `docs/pitch`.

Update relevant index or navigation files when pages are added, removed, moved,
or renamed. Use relative links, avoid duplicating an authoritative explanation,
and document only behavior supported by implementation or an explicitly marked
planning artifact.
